claims.claim: The diagnostic pins RUN-233-002-V002's complete historical population, subtracts exactly the three specified fixed identities, and reports bounded historical identity drift before execution.
The fixed no-argument command executes one residual-only n12 phase and conditionally one full-suite n12 phase, using wrapper-equivalent temporary geometry without retries or fallback.
The observer retains bounded typed failure facts and Git/PUSH observations while delegating original Git calls exactly once and excluding raw operands and private output.
Full-suite residual failures include bounded worker predecessors, co-active safe identities, and read-only installed-provenance relations without scheduling barriers or installed-state writes.
Validation rejects subject changes, collection/execution contradictions, worker or mutable-root isolation failures, observation overflow, and unsafe schema fields.

Regression tests cover the required classifications, historical drift, context bounds, provenance relations, Git delegation/redaction, and subject/isolation failures; the commit changes only the three permitted diagnostic files.
